title: DNA Extraction from Peripheral Blood Using FlexiGene DNA Kit
author: Raul Escamilla
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rtwd6pe
materials: TE solution (10 mM Tris pH 8.0, 0.1 mM EDTA)
1) Extract DNA from buffy coat (FLEXIGENE KIT (Qiagen), follow basically manufacturer’s instructions) a) Obtain 5 ml of peripheral blood in vacutainer tubes with EDTA from each patient.
g) Add 500 µl Buffer FG2/QIAGEN protease (solution FG2/protease) close the tube and vortex immediately until the pellet is completely homogenized.

steps.title: Isolate Buffy Coat
steps.instruction: Centrifuge whole blood at 2000 x g for 10 minutes at 4°C to obtain approximately 500 µl of the leukocyte-enriched fraction (buffy coat).

steps.title: Transfer Buffy Coat
steps.instruction: Transfer the buffy coat into a 2 ml O-ring Tube using a disposable 3 ml transference pipette.

steps.title: Lysis and Mixing
steps.instruction: Add Buffer FG1 to the tube containing the buffy coat and mix.

substeps.instruction: Pipet 1250 µl Buffer FG1 into each tube.
Mix by inverting the tubes 5 times.

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples for 20 seconds at 10,000 x g in a fixed-angle rotor microcentrifuge.

steps.title: Remove Supernatant
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and dry the tube.

substeps.instruction: Discard the supernatant.
Leave the tube inverted on a clean sheet of absorbent paper for 1 min, ensuring the pellet remains in the tube.

steps.title: Incubation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube briefly (3-5 s), then incubate in a heating block at 65°C for 10 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µl Isopropanol (100%).
Mix thoroughly by inversion until the DNA precipitate is visible as threads or a clump.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture for 3 min at 10,000 x g.

steps.title: Wash DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and wash the pellet with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and briefly invert the tube onto a clean piece of absorbent paper for 1 minute, ensuring the pellet remains in the tube.
Add 500 µl 70% ethanol.
Vortex for 5 seconds to resuspend the pellet.

steps.title: Final Centrifugation and Drying
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the pellet and remove all remaining ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 3 min at 10,000 x g.
Discard the supernatant and leave the tube inverted on a clean piece of absorbent paper for at least 1 minute, ensuring the pellet remains in the tube.
Use a sample concentrator to remove remaining ethanol under vacuum at 65°C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: DNA Elution and Storage
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA in TE solution and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µl TE solution (10 mM Tris pH 8.0, 0.1 mM EDTA).
Incubate for 1 hour at 65°C.
Store at 4°C until quantification.

steps.title: Quantify Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Quantify the DNA using a NanoDrop 2000 Spectrophotometer.

substeps.instruction: Perform two independent measurements of 2 µl each and calculate the mean for each sample.
Analyze 260/280 and 260/230 ratios in combination with overall spectral quality (expected 260/280 ~1.8 and 260/230 ~2.3).

steps.title: Prepare Genotyping Experiment
steps.instruction: Set up the ABI 7500 DNA detection system.

substeps.instruction: Create a new experiment using the Design Wizard in the 7500 software.
Open the example experiment file created in allelic discrimination.

steps.title: Load and Run Genotyping
steps.instruction: Load the samples and perform the thermal cycling protocol.

substeps.instruction: Load the plate into the precision plate holder, ensuring proper alignment.
Perform initial denaturation at 94°C for 15 minutes.
Perform 40 cycles of 94°C for 20 seconds and 60°C for 1 minute.

steps.title: Analyze Genotyping Results
steps.instruction: Review the results using the Allelic Discrimination Plot.

substeps.instruction: Contrast the normalized reporter dye fluorescence (Rn) for the allele-specific probes of the SNP assay.
Verify that the plot displays clusters for the three possible genotypes (Allele 1 homozygous, Allele 2 homozygous, and Allele 1/2 heterozygous) and a cluster for the negative controls.
